safety.instructions: Is the user prompt in `message` unsafe? Unsafe categories: hate or identity hate; sexual content; suicide and self-harm; violence; guns and illegal weapons; threats; personal or sensitive information and privacy violations; sexual content involving minors; criminal planning or confessions; harassment; controlled or regulated substances; profanity; illegal activity; immoral or unethical activity; unauthorized professional advice; political misinformation or conspiracy; fraud or deception; copyright, trademark, or plagiarism violations; high-risk government decision making; malware; manipulation.

criteria.unsafe: The prompt falls into any listed category, including unauthorized professional advice, profanity, or reproducing protected text.
criteria.safe: A prompt in no listed category, including a sensitive topic raised for legitimate informational, educational, creative, or support purposes.
